instruction: Treat freecad_task-13_input.step in FreeCAD as the reference. For the steps below, launch FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad` and open `freecad_task-13_input.step` there. Use the Part Design workbench for the modeling operations; activate or create the relevant Body, create new sketches for sketch-based features, and use feature or placement tools for the requested edits. Keep the first cylindrical pin fixed. Move the second pin by +25 mm along Y. Rotate the third pin by +90 degrees about an X-parallel axis through the center of its bottom circular face, then move that rotation pivot to (50 mm, 25 mm, 0 mm). Export the three-pin compound as /home/user/Desktop/freecad_task-13_output.step.
